unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The XML links an ACS supporting-information PDF, but the local packet, raw folder, landed asset folder, supplementary index, and archive manifest contain no local supplementary asset to parse.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Does not block the Table 1 MBC records because the primary XML and PDF text contain the complete reported MBC values and methods. It prevents primary-source exact sequence confirmation from Figure S1, so database sequence status is preserved as sequence_modified_not_normalized rather than source_verified.
